QUOTE: Don't hand-edit the switch blocks in `library/error.c`. They sit between `/* Begin Auto-Generated Code. */` and the end of the table, and are generated by `scripts/generate_errors.pl`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says not to hand-edit error.c and to regenerate it. But it says to define the constant in the module header, not to add a /** */-documented #define there. It also says the generator's input is a `data_dir` file, which is the wrong mechanism.
